proposal: Contract pieces SPEC §19 phase 1 implies (the personal learning agent, W8; JM-D21 to JM-D29 approved 2026-10-29), proposed by W8 phase 1. Each entry is a JSON Pointer into a contract under contracts/ (an endpoint for TABLE API-27a, or a CHECK in contracts/data/schema.sql marked storage) and the value to add there. They were adopted in the same change (python -m jana_tools codegen), so the generated Python and TypeScript bindings carry them and no local allowance applies; this file records what was added and why. Entries marked phase 2 are §19.3.3's; entries marked phase 3 are §19.3.4's and §19.3.5's.

additions.why: Study chat, quizzes and flashcards are pitched at the learner's level, bands and watched misconceptions; the block is the cloud variant's structured form, so a cloud Study request carries MDL-25's fields only.

value.description: Who is asking a Study request (SPEC §19.3.1, MDL-25's set and nothing else): the profile's level and subjects, up to 24 knowledge components in three bands (the current focus first, then the most recently practised) and up to 8 misconceptions being watched (active or resolving). Rendered by the engine from the frozen learner snapshot (memory/snapshot.py learner_block_data); never notes, preferences, names or dates.

additions.why: The body net/study.py sends gains the block; JobCreate is unchanged (the engine renders it, the app never sends it). The gateway keeps it in the model's user message beside the passages.

value.description: What the learner did in Study (SPEC §19.3.2, JM-D22, JM-D26): activity, not mastery. `kc_tags` are topic-derived (engine/study_topics.py matches pack topic titles in the item's words; they say which topics an item names, never which skills it tests); the mastery, review and misconception projections ignore this event. `ref` is aid:<aid_id>, att:<attempt_id>:<item_index> or card:<card_id>: never a title, a source id or text.
